name: ballot
description: Ballot type: first_vote (Erststimme, candidate) or second_vote (Zweitstimme, party list)

name: voters
description: Number of voters including invalid ballots (Wähler)

name: valid_votes
description: Number of valid votes (gültige Stimmen); counts votes not ballots under multi-vote systems

name: turnout
description: Voter turnout as a percentage (0-100), number_voters divided by eligible_voters times 100, capped at 100

name: party
description: Party or list, GERDA normalized name

name: vote_share
description: Party vote share as a percentage (0-100); denominator is number_voters for federal and European, valid_votes otherwise
